rows.title: Captions (Live)
rows.justification: Captions (Live): requires a running live stream; a static page exposes no signal about whether a future broadcast will be captioned.

rows.title: Sign Language (Prerecorded)
rows.justification: Sign Language (Recorded) (AAA): whether a recording carries a sign language interpretation is a property of the media track, not of the page markup.

rows.title: Extended Audio Description (Prerecorded)
rows.justification: Extended Audio Description (AAA): whether the pauses in a video carry enough description is a property of the audio track, not of the page markup.

rows.title: Media Alternative (Prerecorded)
rows.justification: Media Alternative (Recorded) (AAA): whether a linked document is a full alternative for the recording can only be decided by reading both.

rows.title: Audio-only (Live)
rows.justification: Audio-only (Live) (AAA): requires a running live stream; a static page exposes no signal about whether a future broadcast carries a text alternative.

rows.title: Meaningful Sequence
rows.justification: Meaningful Sequence: the correct reading order is defined by authorial meaning; DOM-vs-visual order mismatches are routinely intentional, so any static heuristic is a noise generator. axe-core likewise ships no 1.3.2 rule.

rows.title: Sensory Characteristics
rows.justification: Only experimental scanners cover this criterion: llm-sensory-characteristics: LLM scanner: no stability record (tests/data/harness/harness-llm.json is missing; run harness:llm --runs 3 --json)

rows.title: Identify Purpose
rows.justification: Identify Purpose (AAA): asks for personalization semantics (WAI-ADAPT style annotations) that no scanner here measures; landmark structure is 1.3.1, not this.

rows.title: Low or No Background Audio
rows.justification: Low or No Background Audio (AAA): whether speech has background sound behind it, and 20 dB below it, is a property of the audio signal, not of the page.

rows.title: Visual Presentation
rows.justification: Only experimental scanners cover this criterion: llm-visual-presentation: LLM scanner: no stability record (tests/data/harness/harness-llm.json is missing; run harness:llm --runs 3 --json)

rows.title: No Timing
rows.justification: No Timing (AAA): a time limit on user activity shows up while the page runs; it needs state interaction and observation, not a reading of the markup.

rows.title: Interruptions
rows.justification: Interruptions (AAA): whether an interruption can be postponed is runtime behaviour; axe ships meta-refresh-no-exceptions disabled, so nothing runs for it.

rows.title: Re-authenticating
rows.justification: Re-authentication (AAA): whether data survives a re-login is server and session behaviour that a single page load does not expose.

rows.title: Timeouts
rows.justification: Timeouts (AAA): whether an inactivity timeout discards user data needs state interaction over time, not a static reading.

rows.title: Headings and Labels
rows.justification: Headings and Labels: whether a heading or a label describes its topic is a judgement about meaning. An empty heading is axe-core `empty-heading` and an unnamed control is axe-core `label`; what is left needs a reader. axe-core ships no 2.4.6 rule either.

rows.title: Location
rows.justification: Location (AAA): whether a user can determine their position requires the surrounding set of pages and its information architecture, not one page.

rows.title: Section Headings
rows.justification: Only experimental scanners cover this criterion: llm-semantic-text: LLM scanner: no stability record (tests/data/harness/harness-llm.json is missing; run harness:llm --runs 3 --json)

rows.title: Focus Not Obscured (Enhanced)
rows.justification: Only experimental scanners cover this criterion: llm-focus-appearance: LLM scanner: no stability record (tests/data/harness/harness-llm.json is missing; run harness:llm --runs 3 --json)

rows.title: Focus Appearance
rows.justification: Only experimental scanners cover this criterion: llm-focus-appearance: LLM scanner: no stability record (tests/data/harness/harness-llm.json is missing; run harness:llm --runs 3 --json)

rows.title: Target Size (Enhanced)
rows.justification: Target Size (Enhanced) (AAA): the AA minimum (2.5.8, 24x24 with the spacing exception) is automated in input-modalities; the 44x44 AAA size is a design review item.

rows.title: Unusual Words
rows.justification: Only experimental scanners cover this criterion: llm-semantic-text: LLM scanner: no stability record (tests/data/harness/harness-llm.json is missing; run harness:llm --runs 3 --json)

rows.title: Abbreviations
rows.justification: Only experimental scanners cover this criterion: llm-semantic-text: LLM scanner: no stability record (tests/data/harness/harness-llm.json is missing; run harness:llm --runs 3 --json)

rows.title: Reading Level
rows.justification: Only experimental scanners cover this criterion: llm-reading-level: LLM scanner: no stability record (tests/data/harness/harness-llm.json is missing; run harness:llm --runs 3 --json)

rows.title: Pronunciation
rows.justification: Pronunciation (AAA): whether a word is ambiguous in a way that changes meaning is a reading of the text in its language; the page carries no signal for it.

rows.title: Change on Request
rows.justification: Change on Request (AAA): an automatic context change happens at runtime; axe ships meta-refresh-no-exceptions disabled, so nothing runs for it either.

rows.title: Consistent Help
rows.justification: Only experimental scanners cover this criterion: llm-consistent-help: LLM scanner: no stability record (tests/data/harness/harness-llm.json is missing; run harness:llm --runs 3 --json)

rows.title: Error Prevention (Legal, Financial, Data)
rows.justification: Error Prevention (Legal, Financial, Data): the criterion applies only to pages that commit the user legally or financially, and is met by reversibility, checking or confirmation, all of which are server-side behaviour a static page does not expose.

rows.title: Help
rows.justification: Help (AAA): whether help is context-sensitive for the field that needs it is a judgement about the process, and the help may live behind an interaction.

rows.title: Error Prevention (All)
rows.justification: Error Prevention (All) (AAA): reversibility, checkability and confirmation of a submission is server-side behaviour that is not observable from the page.

rows.title: Redundant Entry
rows.justification: Only experimental scanners cover this criterion: llm-redundant-entry: LLM scanner: no stability record (tests/data/harness/harness-llm.json is missing; run harness:llm --runs 3 --json)
